### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Deferred Review Nitpick (test-isolation gap surfaced during 3ebb completion-verification)

#### Expected Behavior
test_T17_empty_not_promotion should isolate the BRANCH env var before invoking _branch_is_staged_promotion with an empty arg, so the test exercises the no-arg path deterministically.

#### Actual Behavior
Under PR_LIB_MODE=1 sourcing, the ambient BRANCH env leaks into `[[ "${1:-${BRANCH:-}}" == staged-* ]]` — the production fallback to $BRANCH is CORRECT (intended behavior), but the test does not unset/isolate BRANCH, so T17 reports a false FAIL (46/47). Implementation is not defective; the test needs `BRANCH= ` isolation around the empty-arg invocation. Low priority — does not affect production behavior or CI (the suite is otherwise green).
data.title: [test-merge-to-main-resume-inc008]: T17_empty_not_promotion leaks ambient BRANCH into empty-arg case -> false FAIL under PR_LIB_MODE=1
